intro.uz: Bekzod oddiy bir kunini tasvirlaydi. Oʻqishdan oldin oʻylab koʻring: siz ertalab soat nechada turasiz?

paragraphs.en: My name is Bekzod. I live in Fergana. On weekdays, I get up at half past six. I wash my face and get dressed. Then I have breakfast with my family. We usually eat bread and eggs and drink green tea.
paragraphs.uz: Mening ismim Bekzod. Men Fargʻonada yashayman. Ish kunlari soat olti yarimda turaman. Yuzimni yuvaman va kiyinaman. Keyin oilam bilan nonushta qilaman. Biz odatda non va tuxum yeymiz, koʻk choy ichamiz.

paragraphs.en: School starts at eight o'clock. I go to school by bus. It takes twenty minutes. I have six lessons every day. I never sleep in class!
paragraphs.uz: Maktab soat sakkizda boshlanadi. Men maktabga avtobusda boraman. Yoʻlga yigirma daqiqa ketadi. Har kuni oltita darsim bor. Men darsda hech qachon uxlamayman!

paragraphs.en: I come home at two. After lunch, I do my homework. In the evening, I sometimes help my father in the garden. We have dinner at seven. I go to bed at ten.
paragraphs.uz: Uyga soat ikkida kelaman. Tushlikdan keyin uy vazifamni bajaraman. Kechqurun baʼzan otamga bogʻda yordam beraman. Soat yettida kechki ovqat yeymiz. Soat oʻnda uxlashga yotaman.

grammar.example: I get up at half past six.
We usually eat bread and eggs

explain.uz: U Fargʻonada yashaydi: «I live in Fergana.»

questions.prompt: What time does Bekzod get up on weekdays?

explain.uz: «On weekdays, I get up at half past six.» — half past six = olti yarim (6:30).

questions.statement: Bekzod drinks green tea at breakfast.

explain.uz: Nonushtada: «We usually eat bread and eggs and drink green tea.»

questions.prompt: How does Bekzod go to school?

explain.uz: Maktab soat sakkizda boshlanadi: «School starts at eight».

questions.statement: Bekzod does his homework before lunch.

explain.uz: Tushlikdan keyin: «After lunch, I do my homework.»
«I go to bed at ten.» Soat yettida esa kechki ovqat yeyishadi.
